insight: Co-founded by two Columbia roommates — one off Microsoft's OpenAI Innovation Team — and raised $7.4M led by Insight Partners.
name: HoneyHive
tagline: The observability and evaluation layer for production AI agents.
description: A platform that unifies monitoring and testing for LLM apps and agents into one improvement loop: distributed tracing, online evaluations and alerts, offline experiments, annotation queues for expert feedback, and CI/CD-integrated regression testing. Built OpenTelemetry-native with support for 100+ models and agent frameworks. The free Developer tier covers small teams; Enterprise adds scale, self-host, and compliance.
edge: OpenTelemetry-native loop that turns production failures into test cases, with strong human-evaluation tooling.
